services.name: Island Adventure Miami
services.desc: Enjoy an unforgettable adventure at our island destination - usually Flagler or one of the many island or sandbars in Biscayne Bay. Flagler Island also known as Monument Island is located directly across from Star Island and the Mansions of Miami's rich and famous. On this trip you can truly experience the Miami lifestyle sharing a wide array of complimentary water toys such as kayaks, paddle boards and our giant water trampoline, or just relax on the giant floating water mat or on the beach. This trip departs from Bayside Marketplace and Marina, directly across from the American Miami's only Tiki style Island Adventure Catamaran Escape.

services.name: Sunset Cruise Miami: Cast Away the Day
services.desc: A perfect way to end the day. This evening cruise calls for sun dresses, sandals and chilled wine. Take advantage of one of Florida's finest highlights upon our comfortable catamaran as we sail along the Miami Skyline and enjoy a beautiful sunset on Biscayne Bay or Miami's South Beach. Sails up, sea breezes and salt air increase everyone's taste for fun. Calypso music and breaking waves provide a tropical rhythm. Look back at the land as the sun slips away casting fiery hues of orange and red. 2 hours Frequently Asked Questions Do I have to purchase tickets in advance? Tickets Best Sunset Cruise in Miami, Large Groups Available

services.name: Catamaran Reef Sail
services.desc: An unforgettable reef sail and snorkeling adventure aboard the Spirit of Lauderdale begins with a tour through Millionaires Row on the Intracoastal Waterway to Port Everglades past the Cruise Ship port and then we head out to the beautiful Ft Lauderdale ocean waters. Please note that our Caribbean Reef Sail is only offered on Saturday and Sunday mornings and departs at 9:30 am. Bookings are accepted day of and up to 14 days in advance, based on availability. Available dates are in yellow on the booking calendar to the right. The natural coral reef is located about 1/4 mile offshore. All ages• 2.5 hours • Weekends only

services.name: Miami 4th of July Cruise
services.desc: Make the most of your 4th of July holiday this year, Join Tropical Sailing Catamarans for our Annual 4th of July Party Cruise. Jump aboard the Caribbean Spirit, as it takes sail to find the prime location for viewing a wide array of Fireworks from multiple locations. Sit back and relax as the sun slips away casting fiery hues of orange and red, giving way to Fireworks filling the night sky. From the catamaran we will be able to view the displays of Downtown, South Beach, Fisher Island and more, while listening to a selection of Caribbean, Miami sounds and patriotic music playing in the Ages 2+ • 3 hours

services.name: Fort Lauderdale's Annual New Year's Eve Cruise
services.desc: Cruise Into The New Year With Spirit! Aboard The Spirit of Lauderdale. Enjoy Music, Fun Holiday Lights And Fireworks As We Tour the Waterways of Fort Lauderdale! View the fireworks from Downtown and surrounding areas. Come spend a fantastic evening aboard Spirit Catamarans and enjoy a New Year’s Eve extravaganza. You will be pampered aboard our beautiful vessels and enjoy snacks, soft drinks, beer, wine and a champagne toast as we cruise into 2026! See sights such as: Spectacularly decorated Waterfront Homes, Downtown, MegaYachts, Mansions and Cruise Ship Port This trip includes an open bar Ages 2+ • 3 hours
